Biography [ ] Born in 1852 in Cobh ( then known as Queenstown ) , Ireland , Regan immigrated to the United States and was living in New York City when he joined the U.S. Navy . He served as an ordinary seaman on the USS Pensacola . [ 1 ] On the morning of July 30 , 1873 , Pensacola was in the harbor of Coquimbo , Chile , when a northerly gale began . During the high winds , one of Regan 's crewmates , Ordinary Seaman Peter Linguist , fell
